title: Discontinuance Decision No. 1145/2022
text:
GE. 
Committee against Torture 
 
 Decision adopted by the Committee under article 22 of the 
Convention, concerning communication No. 1145/2022*, ** 
Communication submitted by: 
A.S. (represented by counsels, Mr. Nikola 
Ristovic and Ms. Mina Radoncic) 
Alleged victim: 
The complainant 
State party: 
Serbia 
Date of complaint: 
8 August 2022 (initial submission) 
Substantive issue: 
Deportation to Kyrgyzstan; risk of torture 
1. The communication was submitted by Mr. A.S., Kyrgyz national of Uzbek ethnic origin. 
He alleges that his extradition would amount to a violation by the State Party of his rights 
under articles 3, 14 and 15 of the Convention. He claims that he faces a risk of torture 
and ill-treatment by law-enforcement authorities, a risk of denial of fair trial guarantees 
in his criminal proceedings, and a lack of access to an effective remedy for potential acts 
of torture or ill-treatment upon return, in view of the nature of the charges against him 
and his Uzbek ethnicity. The complainant is represented by counsels. 
2. On 10 August 2022, the communication was registered and the request for interim 
measures was granted. The State Party was requested to refrain from extraditing Mr. A.S. 
to Kyrgyzstan while his communication was under consideration by the Committee. 
3. On 10 August 2022, the State party was requested to provide the observations on both 
the admissibility and the merits of the author’s allegations within six months of the date 
of the note, and no later than 10 February 2023. On 24 March 2023, the State Party 
submitted its observations on the admissibility and merits. 
4. On 15 January 2024, the complainant was requested to submit his comments on the State 
party’s submission no later than 15 March 2024. On 8 December 2025, the complainant 
was sent a final reminder to submit his comments on the State party’s observations. 
5. At its meeting on 17 April 2026, in view of the fact that the complainant did not submit 
his comments and the Committee had no further means of contacting him, the Committee 
decided to discontinue its consideration of communication No. 1145/2022. 
 
 
 
 
 
* Adopted by the Committee at its eighty-fourth session (13 April–1 May 2026). 
 
** The following members of the Committee participated in the examination of the communication: Jorge 
Contesse, Lorena Gonzáles Pinto, Claude Heller, Erdogan Iscan, Peter Vedel Kessing, Liu Huawen, 
Maeda Naoko, Moulaye Abdallah, Ana Racu and Abderrazak Rouwane.
